title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics integration and quality gating improvements
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: the eval harness CI was aggregating only suite-level metrics which masked prompt-level regressions and made it hard to triage quality drops during model rollouts. This change adds per-prompt metric collection, an integration that surfaces prompt-level precision/recall/F1/AUC where applicable, and wiring to the CI gating flow so that failing prompts can be flagged and optionally block merges. Changes are backwards-compatible and gated behind a config flag 'EVAL_PER_PROMPT_METRICS' to allow staged rollout. Summary of changes: add per-prompt metrics collector and histogram exporter; extend ci-gate to evaluate per-prompt deltas against baseline thresholds; add a human-readable per-prompt report artifact and a compact machine-readable JSON artifact consumed by the gating job; add docs and a toggle for strict-quality gating for protected repos. Testing and rollout: unit tests for collector and exporter, integration tests that run a small sample prompt set in CI, and manual verification on staging. Rollout will be: enable non-blocking reporting on staging (1 week), enable optional blocking gating for a subset of repos (2 weeks), and enable strict gating for all eval-harness protected branches after metrics validation. Checklist: add unit tests, update docs, CI pipeline updated, add Linear/Jira references, update alerting dashboards. Impact: better detection of prompt-specific regressions, improved triage, small CI time increase (sampled integration added), and optional stricter gating for critical routes.

review_comments: Jun Park: Can we ensure the per-prompt artifacts are scrubbed of PII before upload? Response: Yes — metrics collector strips raw user text and only emits canonical prompt IDs and normalized tokens; added a scrubber and unit tests.

Lina Rodriguez: The gating thresholds seem strict for smaller prompt sets. Suggest adding a minimum-sample exemption. Response: Added a minimum_samples config (default 30) and fallback to suite-level checks if not met.

Samir Patel: CI time increased ~2 minutes on sample runs, is that acceptable? Response: We tested in staging and increased runner parallelism for the reporting job, documented the tradeoff, and made blocking gating opt-in per-repo.
Jun Park: Please add a short blurb in docs on how to interpret the per-prompt precision/recall table. Response: Docs updated with examples and triage playbook.
Lina Rodriguez: Approve after test coverage additions. Response: Added tests and updated coverage report. Approved.
